opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a strong track record, holding a permanent or fixed-term position covering the duration of the award, based in a UK University or UK not-for-profit research organisation. Lead applicant may include up to two Co-applicants covering different Academy remits.
opportunities.summary: Cross-disciplinary, curiosity-driven research awards in partnership with the Royal Society and Royal Academy of Engineering, supported by the Leverhulme Trust, promoting collaboration across science, engineering, social sciences and humanities.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any researcher based in the UK who meets the conditions of the call, across all career stages. Previous successful recipients of this award are not eligible to reapply.
opportunities.summary: Public engagement programme supporting ambitious projects to engage the public with the humanities and social sciences, working in partnership with a GLAM organisation or performing arts organisation.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027

amount.raw: The symposium covers travel, accommodation, and visa costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers affiliated with research institutions in the UK or Germany, in the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Research collaboration symposium on the theme 'Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future', bringing together early career researchers from the UK and Germany to encourage collaboration and networking, with seed funding available for international collaborations.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships

amount.raw: 80 per cent of salary costs, directly allocated and indirect costs under FEC; three-year award

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers in the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research organisation. British citizens and EEA nationals eligible regardless of doctorate origin; any nationality with a UK doctorate eligible. Must have completed viva between 1 April 2024 and 1 April 2027 and not hold a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three-year fellowship for outstanding early-career researchers to pursue an independent research project towards completion of a significant piece of publishable research, funded by DSIT.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers in the humanities and social sciences, ordinarily resident in the UK, holding a current long-term appointment at a UK-based HEI or IRO continuing for the full duration of the award.
opportunities.summary: Awards to promote the acquisition and advancement of skills in relevant areas by UK-based researchers, supporting innovative research methods through skills development, collaboration or dissemination (e.g. quantitative skills, data science, digital humanities, languages).

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Principal Investigator must be a researcher from the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research institute, of postdoctoral or above status, with Co-Applicants based overseas required.
opportunities.summary: International interdisciplinary research projects led by UK-based researchers in the humanities and social sciences, working with international partners, on the theme of Mobilities, ranging across SHAPE and STEM disciplines.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based early- and mid-career researchers from across the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships for UK-based early- and mid-career researchers to develop skills, networks and careers in the creative, cultural, public, private and policy sectors, embedded in the office of the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) in Berlin.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award-holders or applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award in the next six months.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support additional needs that applicants and award-holders may require, such as specific equipment to overcome barriers, assistance for sensory impairment, caring costs for research trips, and support to make applications. Offered on a rolling deadline.

opportunities.title: British Academy/Leverhulme Small Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral scholars (or equivalent) ordinarily resident in the United Kingdom. Independent scholars eligible. Co-applicants may be from anywhere in the world but the Principal Applicant must be ordinarily resident in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Small research grants to cover the cost of expenses arising from a defined research project, tenable for up to 24 months. Funded as a public-private partnership including DSIT, Leverhulme Trust and Wellcome Trust.
